name: E.E.Jornalista Francisco Mesquita
tagline: A public state school bringing education to the East Side of São Paulo since 1970.

about.title: About the school
about.text: A public school in the São Paulo state network, located in Parque Císper, in the Cangaíba district on the East Side of the city. It serves children, teenagers and adults, from Elementary to High School, including Youth and Adult Education (EJA) and technical courses.

history.title: Our history
history.intro: The school is named after journalist Francisco Mesquita, who ran the newspaper O Estado de S. Paulo for more than four decades and took part in defining moments of São Paulo and Brazilian history.

timeline.text: Born in São Paulo on April 22, son of Julio Mesquita, director of O Estado de S. Paulo.
Graduates from the Largo de São Francisco Law School. In 1913 he had been top scorer for Club Athletico Paulistano.
After his father’s death, he takes over the newspaper alongside his brother, Julio de Mesquita Filho.
Fights as a volunteer in the Constitutionalist Revolution. He is arrested and exiled to Portugal.
Elected to the state constituent assembly, he helps create the University of São Paulo (USP).
Held for 40 days during the Estado Novo regime, while the newspaper is under government control until 1945.
Dies in São Paulo on November 8, aged 76.
A state decree of January 21 gives the school, then Ginásio Estadual do Jardim Popular, the name Jornalista Francisco Mesquita.
